nota: Ilustraciones del curso con Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (plantillas/ilustrar.py). Estilo y personajes fijos para que se vean igual en todo el curso. Textos de los prompts en inglés porque el modelo los sigue mejor; las imágenes no llevan texto.
estilo: Warm, friendly flat vector illustration for an online course for small business owners in Soacha, Colombia (a working-class city next to Bogotá). Clean shapes, soft shading, subtle paper texture, natural light. Realistic Colombian people with diverse skin tones and ordinary clothes. Brick houses and small shops typical of Soacha neighborhoods. Palette: warm neutrals and off-white, charcoal #141414 for lines and dark areas, with deep red #c8102e as the only accent color. Simple, uncluttered composition with clear focus on the people. No readable text, letters or numbers anywhere.

personajes.patricia: ONE single woman only, alone, no other people, no background scene. Patricia, a 41-year-old Colombian fast-food cook, medium build, light-olive skin, long straight black hair tied in a high ponytail under a black cap, small hoop earrings, confident smile. Wears a black t-shirt, a deep-red apron, a hairnet visible under the cap, jeans and white sneakers.
personajes.oscar: ONE single man only, alone, no other people, no background scene. Óscar, a 36-year-old Colombian pet-shop owner, tall and slightly heavy, brown skin, short curly black hair, short neat beard, rectangular glasses. Wears a light-grey polo shirt with a small red paw-print patch on the chest, dark jeans and brown sneakers.
personajes.marisol: ONE single woman only, alone, no other people, no background scene. Marisol, a 52-year-old Colombian stationery-shop owner who clearly looks middle-aged (soft wrinkles, a few grey strands), petite, fair-to-medium skin, chin-length straight dark-brown hair with bangs, red-framed glasses. Wears a dark-red cardigan over a white blouse, grey trousers and flat black shoes.

imagenes.escena: A single scene with Patricia appearing only ONCE (do not copy the reference sheet pose). Early evening at Patricia's small fast-food stall in front of a brick house in La Despensa, Soacha: a steel griddle with hot dogs and burgers sizzling and a little smoke, bread buns, sauce bottles, a small menu board with drawings only (no text), plastic stools. Patricia stands behind the griddle holding her smartphone, looking at it with a puzzled expression, one hand holding a spatula.

Three large open cardboard boxes side by side on an off-white background, no text: the left box has coins and banknotes flying INTO it with a red arrow (income); the middle box contains hot dog sausages, bread buns, potatoes and food packaging (cost of what is sold); the right box contains a small shop key, a light bulb, a gas cylinder and a water tap icon (fixed expenses). Clean flat infographic style. No people at all, no human figures, no buildings, no background scenery; only the objects described. Absolutely no words, labels, letters or numbers.
